answer: That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. Because the nebula cliff is fixed at deposit and written down in the ferrous ledger, the tide audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 21 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. That is 35 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
